claims.text: PostgreSQL 15 supports row-level security, so we can use it for tenant isolation.
SQLite WAL mode does not work across a network filesystem, so our shared-NFS design cannot use WAL.
Amazon S3 versioning preserves overwritten object versions, so we can use it for accidental-overwrite recovery.
AWS Lambda functions have a maximum execution timeout of 15 minutes, so the 20-minute export job needs a different runtime.
GitHub Actions supports encrypted repository secrets, so we can store the deployment token there.
The MIT license permits commercial use, so an MIT-licensed parser is eligible for our paid product.
Stripe's payment API expects USD amounts in cents, so our checkout integration must convert dollars before sending the amount.
Redis supports setting a TTL on individual keys, so it can expire each temporary session record automatically.
